# Schemas

The documents Projections reads and writes, as JSON Schema (draft 2020-12), published at
`https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/`. An ID names a major version, which changes only additively; each
release also publishes an immutable snapshot, `<name>/v<major>/<release>.json`, to pin
([versioning](../../contracts.md#versioning-and-publishing)). [Extractions and comparisons](../../guides/schemas.md#extraction-schema) explains the
domain schemas an extraction's `schema` field selects.

| Schema | ID | Describes |
|---|---|---|
| [Domain schema api/v0](api.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/api/v0.json` | Public API declarations: declaration entities carry `data.signature`, and optionally `data.contract`, their compatibility facts in terms every ecosystem shares. |
| [Domain schema architecture/v0](architecture.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/architecture/v0.json` | Components and their connections, as `graph/v0`, for architecture and infrastructure. |
| [CI artifact manifest](artifact.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/artifact/v0.json` | projections.artifact.json at the root of the `projections` Actions artifact: what one workflow run extracted or compared, and the full-byte SHA-256 of every document it uploaded. |
| [Bookmarks](bookmarks.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/bookmarks/v0.json` | `.projections-bookmarks.json` at the repository root: saved comparisons to revisit, each a projection and two revisions. `projections bookmark` reads it; bookmark IDs are unique within the file. |
| [Comparator tests](comparator-tests.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/comparator-tests/v0.json` | Tests for a custom comparator, in the file beside its comparator file (`X.comparator.test.yaml` for `X.comparator.yaml`), never part of the comparator or its digest. Each case gives two extractions and states what the comparator must make of them: partial expectations (step order, steps, changes, counts, metadata, or the error the comparator must fail with) and an optional snapshot of the whole comparison. `projections check` runs them. See docs/contracts.md, "Comparator tests". |
| [Comparator file](comparator.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/comparator/v0.json` | A custom comparator file (`<name>.comparator.yaml`): YAML declarations the rules interpreter runs over the default comparator, sandboxed. Identity passes add correspondences; comparator rules, CEL expressions checked against declared types when the file loads, classify changes, order them into steps and add metadata. See the guide's "Write a custom comparator" and docs/design/declarative-comparators.md. |
| [Saved comparison](comparison-document.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/comparison-document/v0.json` | Two saved extractions and the comparison between them, with the comparator that produced it. |
| [Comparison](comparison.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/comparison/v0.json` | How one extraction became another: correspondence, status, optional summaries and presentation order. Never positions, colors or timing. |
| [Domain schema dag/v0](dag.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/dag/v0.json` | Like `graph/v0`, with no cycles: steps, stages, job or build order. The engine rejects cycles. |
| [Domain schema database/v0](database.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/database/v0.json` | Tables, columns, keys and constraints, and the relations between them; columns carry `data.type`. |
| [Projection definition](definition.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/definition/v0.json` | A projection: an extractor, an optional comparator and a renderer, with their configuration. |
| [Environment](environment.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/environment/v0.json` | How to make a checkout usable for the repository's toolchain extractors, as its CI does: `.github/projections/environment.json` or `.projections/environment.json`. |
| [Saved extraction](extraction-document.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/extraction-document/v0.json` | An extraction with runner-added provenance and its semantic digest. |
| [Extraction](extraction.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/extraction/v0.json` | One aspect of the code at one revision, as produced by an extractor on stdout. |
| [Extractor stdin](extractor-request.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/extractor-request/v0.json` | The document an extractor receives on stdin. |
| [Domain schema graph/v0](graph.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/graph/v0.json` | Entities and directed relationships between them; the general choice. Adds no rules to the envelope. |
| [Domain schema metrics/v0](metrics.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/metrics/v0.json` | Measurements: every entity carries a numeric `data.value`, and optionally a `data.unit`. |
| [Renderer manifest](renderer.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/renderer/v0.json` | `renderer.json`, the manifest a renderer bundle ships beside its `index.html`: its name, the definition renderers it presents, and optionally the comparison modes and extractions it supports. |
| [Scenarios](scenarios.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/scenarios/v0.json` | Authored renderer scenarios: extractions, or before and after extractions with an optional comparator, shown with a renderer. Paths are relative to this file. Scenario IDs are unique within the file. |
| [Domain schema treemap/v0](treemap.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/treemap/v0.json` | A containment forest (at most one parent each, no cycles) whose leaves carry a nonnegative `data.value`. The engine checks the forest and that leaves are weighted. |
| [Vocabulary agentic-workflows/v0](vocabularies-agentic-workflows.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/vocabularies/agentic-workflows/v0.json` | Agentic workflows, such as GitHub Agentic Workflows: what starts each one, what its agent can reach and write, its budgets and imports, and groups of workflows that work together. Defined in docs/models/agentic-workflow-model.md. |
| [Vocabulary dependency-injection/v0](vocabularies-dependency-injection.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/vocabularies/dependency-injection/v0.json` | Dependency-injection containers: services, the registrations that bind them with a lifetime, the implementations they produce, and the services implementations depend on. Defined in docs/models/dependency-injection-model.md. |
| [Vocabulary infrastructure/v0](vocabularies-infrastructure.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/vocabularies/infrastructure/v0.json` | Infrastructure as code and deployment plans: resources, data sources, modules and resource groups, with planned actions. Defined in docs/models/infrastructure-model.md. |
| [Vocabulary runtime-policy/v0](vocabularies-runtime-policy.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/vocabularies/runtime-policy/v0.json` | Kernel runtime policies, such as Tetragon: policies, probes, the hooks they attach to, selectors and the workloads they cover. Defined in docs/models/runtime-policy-model.md. |
| [Vocabulary scenarios/v0](vocabularies-scenarios.md) | `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/vocabularies/scenarios/v0.json` | Renderer fixture scenarios (`projections.scenarios` documents) as data: each scenario with the renderer that draws it and its synthetic extraction, or before, after and their comparison. Defined in docs/models/scenarios-model.md. |
